area_you_are_inside_alert: You are in an area E-Ride paused for safety

reservation_deposit_before_pickup: Once a driver accepts, you pay a small deposit before the pickup. It counts toward your fare.
reservation_free_cancel_until: Free cancellation while no driver has your ride, and until @minutes min before the pickup.
scheduled_awaiting_deposit: Pay the deposit below to book this ride.

market_way_pickup: Pick it up from the seller

market_rule_too_cheap: Too cheap to be true? It usually is. Report it.

market_how_post: Post items with photos and a price
market_how_chat: Chat with buyers and deliver with E-Ride

market_payment_arranged_seller: No more deadline. Hand over the item and close the order with their code.

market_bid_too_high: That is far more than needed. Check the zeros.

market_where_place_hint: Clients come to you: your shop pin and "Ride there".
market_where_client_hint: You go to the client. Their exact place shows once you confirm.
market_where_online_hint: Lessons, design, advice: through the chat or a call.

venue_search_hint: What are you looking for? Shoes, fabric, shed 112...
venue_no_shops: No shop has listed its shed here yet.
venue_list_my_shop: My shop is here: list it
shed_no_location: Turn on your location to be guided to the shed.
shed_far: Take a ride to the market, then walk.

shed_gps_ok: Your position is sure to about @m m

venue_form_shopfront_hint: Buyers look for it when they arrive. Take it from the path in front of your shed.
venue_form_sells_hint: The words buyers search with. Up to 12.
venue_form_verified_warning: Changing your market, block or shed, or moving your pin, removes the E-Ride Verified badge until E-Ride checks again.
venue_form_pin_hint: Stand in front of your shed and tap "Use here". Inside the market the phone can be off by a few metres: adjust the pin if needed.
venue_form_directions_hint: After the fabric sellers, opposite the blue pillar

shed_there_go_down: You are at @building. Go down to the @floor, then find @shed.
venue_form_building_hint: Building, if your shed is in one (optional)

share_shop_how: Tap "Share to Status", choose WhatsApp, then My status. Your link is copied: paste it in the caption so people can tap it.
share_shop_why: People who open your link see your catalogue, even without E-Ride, and can install it to chat with you.
share_shop_link_copied: Link copied: paste it in the caption

store_link_not_here: This store does not serve your area yet.

share_shop_poster_no_app: No app? The catalogue opens in your browser.

pickup_help_write_hint: e.g. Blue gate behind the Presbyterian church

voice_note_driver_hears: Your driver will hear this note
voice_note_not_read: E-Ride could not read it, but your driver will still hear it. Check your places yourself.
voice_note_mic_needed: Allow the microphone to record a voice note
voice_note_too_short: The note was too short. Hold on a little longer.
voice_note_failed: The voice note could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
voice_place_ride: Going to "@place"? Pick the right place:
voice_place_parcel: Sending to "@place"? Pick the right place:
voice_place_none: No place found with that name. Type it in the destination.

assistant_idea_voice: How does the voice note work?

assistant_idea_activity: What is happening with my order?
